blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate has wrapped up its week-long plenary deliberations for the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027, paving the way for the period of amendments before the chamber votes on its version of the spending bill. The Senate began its marathon deliberations for different government agencies on Monday, Nov. 23, and concluded on early Saturday, Nov. 28.
